On desktop (768 px and wider), both remaining "back home" phrasings now point to the app start page:
- The StudioAccessRequired button, from `StudioRoute.tsx`.
- The AI-unavailable error sentence: from 768 px up it uses the new key `console.ai.unavailableErrorDesktop`, added to all 11 locale packs. A phone keeps `console.ai.unavailableError`.

`Clause-②: yes (widening)`: one new i18n key, no retirements.

The first merge-queue attempt failed on an unrelated `AiChatPage.draftInMainArea-34610` navigation assertion. I judged that failure in 7174557923 and re-queued once. The second run went green.

Nothing is left on this card; `pm:dispatched` removed.
